description.raw:
**Purpose of this project**  
This project focuses on further improving OpenProject's support for agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe).

**Product vision**  
Here you can find a detailed vision for agile way of working within OpenProject.  
Blog article: [https://www.openproject.org/blog/future-of-agile-work/](https://www.openproject.org/blog/future-of-agile-work/) 

Video: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1hNBAhBHpHk](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1hNBAhBHpHk) 

**Project goals**

*   Better support for agile artefacts and ceremonies (backlog grooming, sprint planning, retrospectives)
    
    *   Sprint scheduling, start and completion (incl. sprint status)
        
    *   Improved backlog view
        
    *   Automated backlog (showing per default all work packages from the project, except closed and rejected work packages)
        
*   Further improvements for agile boards aligned with agile principles
    
    *   Swimlanes
        
    *   Quick filters
        
    *   Status mapping
        
    *   Automated sprint boards
        
*   Establish agile reports to measure team health and maturity in order to boost continuous improvements
    
    *   burnup charts
        
    *   burndown charts
        
    *   velocity charts
        
    *   number of cards planned, added, completed

statusExplanation.raw:
The backlog and sprints page are continuously being improved with each version; providing stronger support for agile-oriented teams.

**Since version 17.9**

*   A search box and filters are now available in the Backlogs view to support backlog refinement and sprint planning.
    

**Since version 17.8**

*   Changes to Backlog buckets are now recorded under the Activity tab
    

**Since version 17.7**

*   It's now possible to add existing work packages to a sprint, backlog bucket or backlog inbox.
    
*   Multi-select for **All sprints** and **All backlog buckets** filters.
    
*   Multiple active sprints as an Enterprise add-on
    

————————

**On future releases:**

Version 18.0 is scheduled for release on **12.02.2026**, introducing new and improved agile reporting features.

A [**blogpost**](https://www.openproject.org/blog/openproject-agile-reporting/) and a [**video**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2FpGM6i40j8) on the future of agile reporting have also been published to inform users' on what's coming next and to build anticipation.

subject: Backlogs should include tasks from subprojects

description.raw:
It would be great if task from subprojects included in a version of a project appear in the backlogs module.

We have a project with a common SPRINT version for our Dev Team, who is working in different projects (which are subjproject of this one) and we want to use the taskboard as a common for that sprint.

Do you see it useful (or another way to accomplish that)?
